title: briza spicata
intro: Briza spicata, commonly known as Quaking Grass, is a species of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is known to have various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, soothing digestive issues, and acting as an expectorant to relieve respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Briza spicata include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antispasmodic properties, which can help to calm the nervous system and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Briza spicata include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
